inkSteps.note: The quieter inks are the theme's ink at an opacity, never a separate gray. Dark / light alphas.

ink-2.purpose: Secondary text, captions, section headings, icon buttons at rest, fading station names.

ink-3.purpose: The faintest text that still passes WCAG AA at 13px; ghost names, ranks, placeholders. Never under 13px.

rule.purpose: Every hairline: borders, row dividers, chart gridlines.

hover-wash.purpose: A hovered button or neighbor row; 0.04 on a ledger row.

pressed-wash.purpose: A pressed neighbor row, and the static skeleton blocks.

display.purpose: One number per station: riders per day on the sign header, counted up once.

headline.purpose: The station name on the sign header, in condensed capitals.

title.purpose: Neighbor names along the line; at 15px semibold, every ledger name; at 700 uppercase tracked 0.06em, the wordmark.

body.purpose: Sentences, story paragraphs, score-part labels, baseline labels.

label.purpose: The secondary size in Ink 2: captions, section headings (500), chips, sources.

caps-label.purpose: The ledger's sort heads only: the single tracked uppercase style.

line-label.purpose: The line name inside a filter bar.

numeral.purpose: Every number inline, at the surrounding size, tabular.

shadows.name: panel
shadows.purpose: The drawer's left edge over the map, from 768px. The only shadow in the system; --shadow is 0 0 0 in the dark theme and 20 21 24 in the light.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: The drawer's entrance and the number's count.

motion.name: drawer-enter
motion.purpose: The drawer slides in 24px from the right; a server-rendered drawer does not animate.

motion.name: row-fade
motion.purpose: Ledger rows on screen fade in after a sort or filter change; never on a keystroke.

motion.name: count-once
motion.purpose: The riders-per-day number counts up from zero once per open.

motion.name: draw-once
motion.purpose: The chart draws left to right once per open.

motion.name: fly-to
motion.purpose: The map flies to the selected station, padded for the drawer.

motion.name: ring-scale
motion.purpose: The 2px selection ring scales in around the selected mark.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Under prefers-reduced-motion every transition and animation collapses; MotionConfig reducedMotion="user" gates the rest. Nothing loops, nothing exits with animation.

breakpoints.name: md
breakpoints.purpose: The drawer sits over the map; below it the phone layout.

breakpoints.name: lg
breakpoints.purpose: The ledger column stays beside an open drawer.

dimensions.name: sheet-snaps
dimensions.purpose: The phone sheet's snaps, low to high: the ledger's head alone, the opening snap, the top.

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: The only text button: a hairline outline with no fill at rest, 36px tall (32px inside a ledger row), 13px label, optional 14px icon. Hover washes 6% ink; active moves it down 1px.

narrative.overview:
Ghost Stops is set like a CTA platform sign that happens to be interactive. The field is black, the type is white, and the only color on it is the bar that says which line runs here. Station names are set in Archivo's condensed cut, in capitals, the way they are on the sign; every number is set in a monospaced face so columns of riders line up like a timetable. The light theme is the same sign printed on tile: Tunnel Black becomes the ink, Station Tile the field, and nothing else changes.

The mood is quiet and evidentiary. Chrome recedes to hairlines and secondary ink so the content carries the page, and every figure stands next to its date, its method, and its source. The ghost is a wayfinding glyph, not a costume: a station fades off the network by losing ink, and the word for its tier is always written beside it. Hue belongs to the lines, ghostliness belongs to ink, and selection belongs to inversion.

The one confirmed anti-reference is the retired SaaS dashboard skin: glass panels, gradient fills, five disagreeing score color scales, traffic-light badges, status dots, and a "Live" pill. None of it returns.
keyCharacteristics: Two neutrals per theme and the eight official CTA line colors; no other color exists.
Ghostliness is ink presence and mark shape (solid, hollow, 72% hollow, ghost glyph), never a hue.
Selection and focus invert ink and surface; there is no accent color.
Archivo for words, with the condensed width for station names; JetBrains Mono, tabular, for every number.
Flat surfaces, hairline rules, square panels, 4px controls; one structural shadow on the drawer.
Motion is enter, count-once, draw-once, and fly-to, each gated by the reader's reduced-motion preference; nothing loops.

rules.name: The Line-Only Hue Rule
rules.body: A hue appears only where a CTA line runs: tracks, line bars, filter bars, the chart stroke. Chrome, states, errors, and warnings are ink on a surface with an icon, never red or amber.

rules.name: The Ink Presence Rule
rules.body: Ghostliness is ink and shape, never a hue: healthy is a solid dot at full ink, quiet a hollow ring at full ink, fading a hollow ring at 72%, ghost a small ghost glyph at Ink 3. The tier word is always written beside the mark.

rules.name: The Inversion Rule
rules.body: The one interaction accent is inversion. Selected rows, selected map marks, and text selection swap ink and surface; nothing is ever highlighted with a color.

rules.name: The Mono Numbers Rule
rules.body: Every number on screen is set in JetBrains Mono with tabular figures, whatever its size or context, including dates (2026-07-31) and percentages inside a sentence.

rules.name: The One Caps Rule
rules.body: Uppercase is the station name on the sign, the wordmark, and the 11px sort heads. Nowhere else.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: Headings are sentence case and type only: no icons, no discs, no rules through them. "Why it's fading", "Along the Green Line", "Sources".

rules.name: The One Shadow Rule
rules.body: The drawer's edge is the only shadow. Anything else that needs separation gets a hairline or the second surface.

dos: Do set every number in JetBrains Mono with tabular figures, including dates and percentages inside sentences.
Do write the tier word beside every presence mark; the mark is decorative and the word is the meaning.
Do use inversion (ink fill, surface text) for the selected row, the selected map mark, and text selection.
Do separate sections with a hairline at 12% ink and a 13px sentence-case heading in Ink 2; group with rules and spacing, not boxes.
Do state freshness as a dated sentence ("Data through 2026-07-31") and explain CTA's lag separately from a failed refresh.
Do keep text at 11px or larger and Ink 3 at 13px or larger, and check both themes against WCAG AA.
Do make every row that opens something a real button or link with the shared 2px focus ring.
Do take line colors from the one table and set text on a line color in whichever theme ink contrasts more.
donts: Don't introduce a hue for anything other than a CTA line: no accent color, no red errors, no amber warnings, no score color scales.
Don't express ghostliness or a score as a color, a gradient, a gauge, or a progress track.
Don't add shadows, blur, glass, gradients, noise, or cards; the drawer's edge is the only shadow.
Don't animate anything on a loop, animate an exit, or float the ghost.
Don't use a status dot, a "Live" badge, or a colored pill for freshness.
Don't call a healthy station a ghost, or use decline verbs on a growing number.
Don't add a third typeface, a serif, or a second uppercase tracked style.
Don't round a panel, a bar, or a row; only controls take the 4px radius and only dots are round.
Don't write an em dash in rendered text.
